item.title: The Price of Power
item.description: UK industrial electricity prices are the highest in the developed world. UK productivity growth is among the lowest in the G7. This post asks whether the two are connected, does the data, and finds the answer is: probably, but not in the way you might think.

item.title: The Royal Charter of the Bank of England (1694)
item.description: The founding document of modern public finance and central banking, establishing the world's first funded national debt.
